changelog: E2M1: the 16 spare Blue Keys and the Sword are no longer checks and are removed from the map.
E2M1: Level Complete pin moved onto the main map next to Pistol Clip 3 and Shotgun 1 (no more detached panel).
Combat logic setting renamed to match the apworld: easy / normal / unhinged.
The pack now checks GitHub for updates when it loads and offers to install new versions (PopTracker asks once whether to trust raw.githubusercontent.com).
Map follows you: the map tab switches to the level you load into (needs a DuskRando build with level reporting). Toggle: AUTO MAP.
Level Complete pins sit on each level's exits (buttons and loading zones); E3M10's is on the final boss.
Removed the red connector lines between map layers.
Initial pack: maps generated from the game's level layouts, basic logic.
